name: Diverse Recommendations
description: Users want a more diverse and dynamic music recommendation system that doesn't recycle the same tracks. This need arises from frustrations with repetitive recommendations and a desire for fresh music discovery.

name: Intuitive Discovery UI
description: Users seek a simplified and intuitive user interface for music discovery, free from clutter and cognitive overload. This need stems from difficulties navigating the app and discovering new music.

name: Transparent Recommendation Logic
description: Users desire transparency into how recommendations are generated, wanting to understand why certain songs are suggested. This need emerges from a lack of trust in the current recommendation algorithm.

name: Social Music Discovery
description: Users want an in-app social layer for music discovery and sharing, enabling them to explore music with friends and like-minded individuals. This need arises from a desire for social interaction around music.

name: Mood-Based Discovery
description: Users wish for a feature that allows them to discover music based on their current mood or activity, seeking a more personalized music experience. This need is reflected in complaints about the lack of a 'Discover Weekly' equivalent.
